note: Canonical note for a place, under `30 Canon/32 Locations/`. Machine source: `00 Meta/Templates/entity-location.md`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `location`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text. The location's canonical name. Should match the note title.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: List of text. Other names for the place.

fields.name: world
fields.description: A single `[[Location]]` link to the parent place, forming a hierarchy (room → building → area → world). Leave empty for a top-level location. The hierarchical Locations view walks this chain.

fields.name: locationType
fields.description: Select — one of `world | realm | area | landmark | building | room`. The tier in the place hierarchy; pair it with `world` to nest correctly.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Text. A human-readable region/address that need not be its own note.

fields.name: inhabitants
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links. Characters who live in or are strongly associated with this place. A typed relation — always wikilinks.

fields.name: first_appearance
fields.description: Text — a `[[scene note]]` link. The scene where the location first appears.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this canon belongs to.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `canon/location` — how views and Bases select location notes.
